sqlquery.from:
(
select t.id,max(coalesce(u.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(u.lastname,'')) ownerName , max(t.name) taskName , max(cast(trunc((extract(epoch FROM ((now()-c.startdate)::interval))+coalesce(cumulativetime,0))/60) as integer)) dateInterval , max(p.name) projectName ,max(ca.name) clientName ,max(w.name) workstreamName ,max(t.number) taskNumber ,max(t.startdate) taskStartDate,max(t.dueDate) taskDueDate, max(et.estimatedtime) estimatedtime, sum(coalesce(tsh.timespent,0)) timespent from "$".task t left join "$".clock c on t.id=c.busObjectId and c.relation in (1,2) left join "$".myuser u on c.ownerId=u.id left join "$".project p on t.projectid=p.id left join "$".crmaccount ca on p.clientid=ca.id left join "$".workstream w on w.projectid=p.id
left join "$".teamEmployee te on te.employeeId=u.id left join "$".projectEmployee pe on te.id=pe.employeeDepartmentId left join "$".employeetask et on et.projectemployeeId=pe.id and t.id=et.taskid
left join "$".timesheet tsh on tsh.employeetaskId=et.id where started is true and t.deleted is not true group by t.id
) t
